correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the Gaussian KL determinant/tracial formula; proved strict coordinate convexity using arithmetic≥harmonic and k≥2; compact cube maximization forces endpoint eigenvalues and quantizes the multiplicities. Verified that the scalar derivative has a unique root, derived uniform weak/strong condition-number expansions and exhibited an SPD nonzero-boundary-coupling Lanczos block matrix attaining the Gaussian KL bound. A standalone standard-library verification program passed 4,032 finite supplemental tests.

value.rationale: Trace-matched isotropic covariance is the precise high-dimensional complement approximation used by the motivating stochastic Lanczos analysis. Exact normalized Gaussian KL is a natural numerical-fidelity invariant, and resolving its worst case over a known spectral condition-number range gives a complete finite-dimensional extremal classification. Sharp O(K) high-contrast growth substantially improves the available O(K^2) sufficient bound; an explicit nonzero-Lanczos-coupling realization validates relevance to the numerical construction. No end-to-end runtime or posterior-calibration claim is made.
